note: Synthetic literature excerpts written for this harness. They are not copied from copyrighted papers. Each is long enough to exercise a literature-node prompt.

excerpts.text: A published functional study transfected BRCA2 c.8009C>T into a homology-directed repair reporter line. HDR efficiency fell to 8% of wild-type across three biological replicates (p<0.001). Protein abundance by Western blot was unchanged. The assay used a calibrated benign and pathogenic control set of 12 variants. The authors conclude a damaging effect on double-strand break repair.

MYH7 p.Arg723Cys was studied in an in vitro motility assay. Actin sliding velocity was 42% of wild-type. Calcium sensitivity of force generation shifted by 0.3 pCa units. The paper reports these values as consistent with a hypertrophic cardiomyopathy mechanism. No mouse model is described.

A saturation genome editing experiment in haploid cells scored BRCA1 c.5266dupC as a loss-of-function allele with a function score of -3.1, below the calibrated pathogenic threshold of -1.0. The experiment included synonymous and known-benign controls on the same exon.

BRCA2 p.Val771Ile was tested in an HDR reporter and a splicing minigene. HDR efficiency was 96% of wild-type. The minigene produced only the canonical transcript. Calibrated benign controls scored 90-110% HDR. The authors report no damaging effect in either assay.

MLH1 p.Lys618Glu was evaluated with an in vitro mismatch-repair assay. Repair efficiency was 102% of wild-type. Nuclear localization was intact. The paper states the assay has been validated against 30 classified missense variants.

The patient presented with infantile spasms, hypopigmented macules, and a retinal hamartoma. Brain MRI showed subependymal nodules. The phenotype is highly specific for TSC2-related tuberous sclerosis complex. No second-locus variant was reported. Family history is negative.

A 24-year-old with maximal left-ventricular wall thickness of 28 mm, systolic anterior motion of the mitral valve, and a family history of sudden death meets diagnostic criteria for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. MYH7 is one of several sarcomere genes that cause this phenotype. The presentation is not specific to a single gene.

A newborn with meconium ileus, sweat chloride 98 mmol/L, and pancreatic insufficiency has a phenotype specific for cystic fibrosis. CFTR is the only gene that causes classic CF. Both alleles were sequenced.

PTEN p.Arg130Gln showed loss of lipid phosphatase activity in a PIP3 hydrolysis assay (remaining activity 4%). AKT phosphorylation increased 3.2-fold. The assay panel matches the ClinGen PTEN VCEP recommended functional criteria for PS3.

BRCA2 p.Asn372His, a common polymorphism, scored within the benign range of an HDR assay (99% of wild-type) and had no splice effect on RNA-seq from carrier lymphocytes. This excerpt exists to measure tokens on a true-negative functional study.

The clinical note lists intermittent headache and non-specific fatigue. No dysmorphic features, no organ-system pattern, and no biochemical signature are described. The phenotype is not specific for any single-gene disorder.

A conference abstract reports 'reduced function' for BRCA2 c.7008A>G without naming the assay, the control set, the numeric result, or the replicate count. Under a strict PS3 rubric this text is insufficient to apply the code.
